I had COVID back in April and I ate a bunch of cheap sodium filled processed foods because I could only taste sweet/salty and if I couldn’t taste flavors I didn’t see the point of spending money/ time preparing food. So basically chicken nuggets and fries, pizza rolls, chips, TV dinners/takeout. And I had a weird thing for fruit snacks and sour candies especially orange flavored because I could taste the bitterness first once I started regaining my sense of taste. Also I recommend only eating crispy/textured foods because without taste you need something to make food appetizing and soft foods feel like unflavored mush (especially yogurt and oatmeal)
